sample.attchmntText: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Senior Management Personnel of the Company
sample.voiceSummary: Dabur India Limited has identified eight employees as Senior Management Personnel with effect from November 14, 2026. The Board categorized the following positions as Senior Management Personnel: Head – Home and Personal Care Business, Mr. Abhishek Jugran; Head – Sales, Mr. Rehan Hasan; Head – Foods and Beverages Business, Mr. Mayank Kumar; Head – Healthcare Business, Mr. Sriram Padmanabhan; Head – Marketing Services, Mr. Anindo Samajpati; Head – Legal, Mr. Himanshu Bhatia; Head – Strategy – CEO Office, Mr. Vaibhav Rathi; and Head – Corporate Communications, Mr. Byas Anand. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is available on the company website.

sample.attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
sample.voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Limited has published a newspaper advertisement on November 13, 2026, inviting the attention of shareholders regarding the transfer of equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund. The notice appeared in the English newspaper Mint across all editions and the Hindi newspaper Hindustan in the Delhi edition. The company has submitted copies of these notices to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India for their information and records.

sample.attchmntText: Cera Sanitaryware Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call
sample.voiceSummary: Cera Sanitaryware Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30th 2026 stood at INR 603 crore, reflecting a 27.4% year-on-year growth. Profit after tax was INR 56 crore, with earnings per share at INR 43.52. EBITDA margins stood at 12.2%. The company reported a 24% growth in sanitaryware and a 38% growth in faucetware. Input costs for brass and gas remained elevated. The company implemented an approximate 8% price increase in faucetware effective from September 1st 2026. Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 897 crore as of September 30th 2026. Capital expense incurred in the first half was INR 27 crore against a planned full-year outlay of approximately INR 43 crore. The company expects operating profitability to improve progressively during the second half of FY27.
